answer: Ephemeral deed arbitration. Each new identity must harbor a unique, time-locked work output keyed to its claimed niche, submitted before any transaction. Validators on the terrace compare submissions against a rotating public corpus and reject duplicates. A bridge contract routes rewards only to identities whose deeds survive review, so a sybil must generate fresh verifiable work per identity, paying compute and review latency per clone—cost that scales linearly with fake accounts and cannot be copied from prior answers.
